verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Grok can connect to email/files/calendar and connectors, generate images/video, and act as a coding/agentic assistant, but there is no documentation of creating or iteratively editing documents/presentations/spreadsheets with export capability (e.g., a canvas/artifact-style document editor). Missing for 10: any evidence of document/presentation creation, iterative editing workflow, and export/download functionality for office-style files.
